62777.subject: Computer Studies
62777.question_text:
(a) (i) What is video conferencing? (ii) Mention four essential items to a video conference.

(III) Give two examples of other hardware components essential to video conference

(b) Give two examples of data cables.
62777.explanation:
(a)(i) Video conferencing is a system that allows people to have conversations and meetings with other people in different locations without leaving their offices.

OR

Video Conferencing is a live visual connection/a visual communication session between two or more users/people residing in separate locations featuring audio and video content transmission in real time.

OR

Video Conferencing is conducting a meeting between two or more participants at different sites/ locations by using Computer network to transmit audio and video data.

OR

Video Conferencing is an online meeting that takes place between users from different locations by connecting different devices with embedded webcams.

(ii) Items essential to a video conference:

ITEMS SELECTED:

  • A tracker ball
  • Codec
  • Broadband
  • A telephone 
  •  MODEM/Router
  • Magnetic Tape drive
  • Webcam
  • Dot Matrix Printer to
  •  
  • (iii) Other hardware components essential to video conferencing:
  • Microphone
  • Headphones/Headsets/Earpiece
  • Speakers
  • Computer System/laptop
  • Smart Television
  • Monitor
  • Interactive board
  • Smart phone

  • Printer cable

  • IDE/EIDE cable

62778.subject: Computer Studies
62778.question_text:
(a) Explain home page.

 (b)(i) Mention two reasons why computers are connected. (ii) Mention two reasons why computers are not connected.

(c) List four additional items needed to send an email.
62778.explanation:
(a) Home page refers to the initial or starting point or default or start up or main webpage of a website, sometimes called front page. It Is the page that automatically loads when a web browser is launched.

OR

Home page is the introductory page of a website typically serving as a table of contents for the site.

OR

Home page is the name of the main page of a website where visitors can find hyperlinks to other pages on the site.

(b)(i) Reasons for connecting computers:

Sharing of hardware resources

Sharing of software resources

Sharing of data/files/information

Reducing cost of operation

All computers can access the Internet through one connection point

Parental control

More business opportunity

Advertisement of Products

Social networking

Research purpose

Enhance learning

Improve access to technical support

Ease of making online transactions

 More visibility

Exchange of ideas

Access to cloud computing and cloud storge

Access to online education

Endless access to information

Easy and effective communication

Selling of Product online

Work from home

Access to global workforce

(ii) Reasons for not connecting the computer:

 Virus would be easily spread among the computers

All the computers become susceptible hackers.

Intrusion of privacy

Identity theft

Hacking

Exam Malpractice

Hearing loss

Neck strain

Online gambling

Depression can set in
Worm attack

Internet addiction

Time wasting and distraction

Display of violent images

Cyber bullying Cyber crime/Internet fraud

Phishing Trolls or abusive people

Weight gain/loss

Cyber relationship addiction

Online computer/gaming addiction

Stalkers

Social isolation

Sleep deprivation

Relationship stress

Cyber sex addiction

(c) Four additional items needed to send email:

Modem/Router,

Network cable;

Browser

ISP to provide Internet access/internet connection

Email software/server to create/send and receive emails

Email address to send/receive emails
